summary: Direct3D on the guest lavapipe against the pinned Debian reference, with a new prefix and an ordinary account

cases.behavior: The d3d-wine row proton-d3d9-d3d9ex runs as test on lavapipe and matches each unit with the stored Debian reference; every probe reads its pixels back

execution.cleanup: the runner kills and reaps its Wine server and Xvfb and removes its private prefix and shader cache on every exit; libetude-case stops QEMU and removes passed overlays, keeping failed overlays and their unit logs

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk on AHCI with rach2.root=ext2, wait for the root, the login prompt and init's record that it started sshd, then for the server's answer on the case's port
mount the second disk read-only and run the named Direct3D row as the ordinary test account through the guest channel

assertions.checks: the guest runner exits 0 and prints the exact D3DROW OK token after comparing each unit, its exit, summaries and pixels or its recorded Linux progress marker

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the row reads its immutable payload disk in a new QEMU boot and a private Proton prefix; the same guest runner is used directly for the Debian reference
